title: Marvelous Designer Discord Contests Are Back: Introducing the Marvelous Winter Market
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/c3ccfa2c78974a988e8f2ea56ecd5fde/images/81e29614506f4313b361ad928835f1abMarvelous%20Winter%20Market%20%281%29.png)  
![9920b9e62c294de4888adf8a479495d7](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/c3ccfa2c78974a988e8f2ea56ecd5fde/images/9920b9e62c294de4888adf8a479495d7Marvelous%20Winter%20Market%20%281%29.png)

We’re excited to bring back Marvelous Designer Discord contests with a brand-new creative challenge: ❄️Marvelous Winter Market❄️

Design winter market looks and scenes. You can focus on characters and their garments (vendor, guard, performer, shoppers) and/or environments (stalls, tents, signs, bags). The finished artwork can range from one highly detailed 3D model, to a scene in a shop, to a bird’s eye view of a bustling market. Be creative with your interpretation of “winter market”. It doesn’t need to be holiday themed, but it can be.

**Prizes**

🥇 First Place: 12 months of FREE Marvelous Designer and a feature on our social media  
🥈 Second Place: 6 months of FREE Marvelous Designer  
🥉 Third Place: 3 months of FREE Marvelous Designer

**Dates**

Begin creating now! Submissions will open January 16th and close January 30th.

**How To Enter**

To enter, just join the official Marvelous Designer Discord server. Come for the contest, stay for the community!

  
[**[Join the official Marvelous Designer Discord Server]**](https://discord.com/invite/pPEmF86DHc)
content_description: Join the Marvelous Designer Discord community to showcase your creativity in the Marvelous Winter Market contest for a chance to win free software and be featured on our social media.
